units.title: Talking about yourself
units.goal: Introduce yourself: name, work, where you live, what you like.
units.grammar: Present simple with I / he / she (I work, she works).
pronunciation_focus: final -s in he works / she lives
practice_sentences: She lives in a big city.
I think he works in sales.

units.title: What did you do?
units.goal: Talk about last weekend or a past experience.
units.grammar: Past simple, regular and common irregular verbs.
practice_sentences: I worked late and watched a movie.
We talked and laughed a lot.
She wanted to visit her parents.

units.title: Daily routine and work
units.goal: Describe your day and your job.
units.grammar: Adverbs of frequency, present simple vs. present continuous.
pronunciation_focus: no extra vowel at the end: big, work, job
practice_sentences: I usually start work at nine.
My job is a big part of my life.

units.title: Plans and the future
units.goal: Talk about plans, intentions and predictions.
units.grammar: going to, will, present continuous for arrangements.
practice_sentences: I'm really going to read more this year.
We'll leave the city in the right season.
Right after the meeting I'm going to sleep.

units.title: Opinions and comparisons
units.goal: Give and defend opinions, compare options.
units.grammar: Comparatives and superlatives, I think / In my opinion, because / although.
pronunciation_focus: cat vs. bet vowels: bad, bed, man, men
practice_sentences: I feel that bad habits are hard to change.
People say the hospital is better than the old one.
That man has a really good plan.
